questionEnglish: What is the speed of light in a vacuum?
explanation: Light travels at its maximum speed in a vacuum, which is approximately 3 x 10^8 meters per second.

questionEnglish: Which type of mirror is commonly used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles?
questionOdia: ଯାନବାହନଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ପଛକୁ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ସାଧାରଣତଃ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ଦର୍ପଣ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ?
explanation: Convex mirrors give an erect, diminished image and have a wider field of view, making them ideal for driver rear-view screens.

questionEnglish: The bending of light when it passes obliquely from one transparent medium to another is called?
questionOdia: ଆଲୋକ ରଶ୍ମି ଏକ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ମାଧ୍ୟମରୁ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ମାଧ୍ୟମକୁ ଗତି କଲେ ଏହାର ଗତିପଥରେ ହେଉଥିବା ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Refraction is the phenomenon of bending of light when it goes obliquely from one optical medium to another due to a change in its speed.

questionEnglish: What is the relationship between the focal length (f) and radius of curvature (R) of a spherical mirror?
questionOdia: ଏକ ଗୋଲକୀୟ ଦର୍ପଣର ବକ୍ରତା ବ୍ୟାସାର୍ଦ୍ଧ (R) ଏବଂ ଫୋକସ୍ ଦୂରତା (f) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସମ୍ପର୍କ କଣ?
explanation: For spherical mirrors of small apertures, the radius of curvature is found to be exactly twice the focal length (R = 2f).

questionEnglish: Which lens is also known as a diverging lens?
questionOdia: କେଉଁ ଲେନ୍ସକୁ ଅପସାରୀ ଲେନ୍ସ (Diverging Lens) ବୋଲି ମଧ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: A concave lens parallel rays of light diverge after refraction, which is why it is called a diverging lens.

questionEnglish: What is the SI unit of the power of a lens?
questionOdia: ଲେନ୍ସର ପାୱାର୍ (Power) ର SI ଏକକ କଣ?
explanation: The power of a lens is measured in Dioptres (D), which is the reciprocal of the focal length expressed in meters (1 D = 1 m^-1).

questionEnglish: An image formed by a plane mirror is always?
questionOdia: ଏକ ସମତଳ ଦର୍ପଣ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହେଉଥିବା ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବ ସଦାସର୍ବଦା କିପରି ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: Plane mirrors always form a virtual, upright (erect) image that is laterally inverted and of the same size as the object.

questionEnglish: If the magnification of an image is negative, what does it indicate about the nature of the image?
questionOdia: ଯଦି ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବର ପରିବର୍ଦ୍ଧନ (Magnification) ଋଣାତ୍ମକ (-) ହୁଏ, ତେବେ ଏହା ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବର କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକୃତିକୁ ସୂଚାଏ?
explanation: A negative sign in magnification value signifies that the image formed is real and inverted with respect to the object.

questionEnglish: Which medium has the highest refractive index?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ମାଧ୍ୟମର ପ୍ରତିସରଣାଙ୍କ (Refractive Index) ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ?
explanation: Diamond has an exceptionally high refractive index of about 2.42, which causes maximum bending and trapping of light inside it.

questionEnglish: Where should an object be placed in front of a convex lens to get a real image of the same size as the object?
questionOdia: ଏକ ଉତ୍ତଳ ଲେନ୍ସ ସମ୍ମୁଖରେ ବସ୍ତୁକୁ କେଉଁଠାରେ ରଖିଲେ ବସ୍ତୁ ସହିତ ସମାନ ଆକାରର ଏକ ବାସ୍ତବ ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବ ମିଳିବ?
explanation: When an object is placed at 2F1 in front of a convex lens, its real and inverted image of identical size forms at 2F2 on the opposite side.
